d:
Uttarakhand Cabinet Minister Subodh Uniyal, who had mocked singer Daler Mehndi on stage, reportedly apologized—a claim made by Daler Mehndi’s brother, Mika Singh. However, Minister Subodh Uniyal has now categorically denied offering any such apology. The minister maintains that he never apologized and that all such claims are false.
